continuousHinting.title: Continuous hinting
continuousHinting.description: Whether to enable continuous hinting (Hinterland mode). Requires enabling autocompletion in the other 'Code completion' settings

suppressContinuousHintingIn.title: Suppress invoke continuous hinting in specific code fragments
suppressContinuousHintingIn.description: An array of CodeMirror tokens for which the continuous hinting should be suppressed. The token names vary between languages (modes).

suppressTriggerCharacterIn.title: Suppress invoke via trigger character in specific code fragments
suppressTriggerCharacterIn.description: An array of CodeMirror tokens for which the auto-invoke after entering a trigger (e.g. `.` in Python or `::` in R) character should be suppressed. The token names vary between languages (modes).

waitForBusyKernel.title: Wait for kernel if busy
waitForBusyKernel.description: Should an attempt to get the kernel response (with timeout as specified by kernelResponseTimeout) be made if kernel is busy? If you often write code in notebook while computations are running for long time (e.g. training models), turning this off might give you faster response times.

theme.title: Completer theme
theme.description: The identifier of a completer theme with icons which indicate the kind of completion. Set to null to disable icons. Search for 'completer themes' in the command palette for a command displaying available themes.

kernelCompletionsFirst.title: Prioritize completions from kernel
kernelCompletionsFirst.description: In case of ties when sorting completions, should the kernel completions receive higher priority than the language server completions?

includePerfectMatches.title: Include perfect matches
includePerfectMatches.description: Should perfect matches be included in the completion suggestions list?

preFilterMatches.title: Pre-filter matches
preFilterMatches.description: Should matches be pre-filtered to ensure typed token is a prefix of the match?

labelExtra.title: Text to display next to completion label
labelExtra.description: What to display next to the completion label, one of: 'detail', 'type', 'source', 'auto'. The default 'auto' will display whichever information is available.

layout.title: Completer layout
layout.description: Layout of the completer, one of: 'detail-below', 'side-by-side'

typesMap.title: Mapping of custom kernel types to valid completion kind names
typesMap.description: Mapping used for icon selection. The kernel types (keys) are case-insensitive. Accepted values are the names of CompletionItemKind and 'Kernel' literal. The defaults aim to provide good initial experience for Julia, Python and R kernels.

disable.title: Disable
disable.description: Disable this feature. Requires reloading JupyterLab to apply changes.

defaultSeverity.title: Default severity level
defaultSeverity.description: Default level of the severity for diagnostics without severity provided by the language server.

debounceDelay.title: Delay between typing and refreshing diagnostic (requires restart)

ignoreCodes.title: Diagnostic codes to ignore
ignoreCodes.description: Codes of diagnostics which should not be shown in the panel nor highlighted in the editor.

ignoreMessagesPatterns.title: Diagnostic messages to ignore
ignoreMessagesPatterns.description: Regular expressions matching messages of diagnostics which should not be shown in the panel nor highlighted in the editor.

ignoreSeverities.title: Diagnostic severity levels to ignore
ignoreSeverities.description: Severities of diagnostics which should not be shown in the panel nor highlighted in the editor.

disable.title: Disable
disable.description: Disable this feature. Requires reloading JupyterLab to apply changes.

schema.title: Code Highlights
schema.description: LSP highlights of the variable under the cursor settings.

debouncerDelay.title: Debouncer delay
debouncerDelay.description: Number of milliseconds to delay sending out the highlights request to the language server; you can get better responsiveness adjusting this value, but setting it to zero can actually slow it down as the server might get overwhelmed when moving the cursor.

removeOnBlur.title: Remove highlights on editor (e.g. cell) blur
removeOnBlur.description: Whether the highlights should disappear after the focus leaves the editor/cell

disable.title: Disable
disable.description: Disable this feature. Requires reloading JupyterLab to apply changes.

schema.title: Code Hover
schema.description: LSP Hover over the code tooltip settings.

autoActivate.title: Automatic hover
autoActivate.description: Automatic activation of hover without pressing a key. It will still be possible to show up tooltips with the modifier key.

delay.title: Hover delay
delay.description: Number of milliseconds after which the hover tooltip should be shown. Ignored if 'Automatic hover' is off.

modifierKey.title: Modifier key
modifierKey.description: Keyboard key which activates the tooltip on hover. The allowed keys are Alt, Control, Shift, and AltGraph. Linux user: Meta key is also supported. Safari users: Meta key is also supported, AltGraph is not supported. To see which physical keys are mapped, visit: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/KeyboardEvent/getModifierState

throttlerDelay.title: Throttler delay
throttlerDelay.description: Number of milliseconds to delay sending out the hover request to the language server; you can get better responsiveness adjusting this value, but setting it to zero can actually slow it down as the server might get overwhelmed when moving the mouse over the code.

cacheSize.title: Cache size
cacheSize.description: Up to how many hover responses should be cached at any given time. The cache being is invalidated after any change in the editor.

disable.title: Disable
disable.description: Disable this feature. Requires reloading JupyterLab to apply changes.

modifierKey.title: Modifier key
modifierKey.description: Keyboard key which needs to be pressed with click to jump. The allowed keys are Alt, Control, Shift, Accel, and AltGraph. Accel corresponds to Control or Meta (Command on Mac). Linux user: Meta key is also supported. Safari users: Meta key is also supported, AltGraph is not supported. To see which physical keys are mapped, visit: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/KeyboardEvent/getModifierState

disable.title: Disable
disable.description: Disable this feature. Requires reloading JupyterLab to apply changes.

language-server.description: Client and server configurations for a single language server

priority.title: Priority of the server
priority.description: When multiple servers match specific document/language, the server with the highest priority will be used

serverSettings.title: Language Server Configurations
serverSettings.description: Configuration to be sent to language server over LSP when initialized: see the specific language server's documentation for more

language_servers.title: Language Server

loggingConsole.title: Logging console type
loggingConsole.description: The console to use for debugging problems with this extension. Allowed values are: browser, floating.

loggingLevel.title: Logging console verbosity level
loggingLevel.description: The verbosity of the console for debugging problems with this extension. Allowed values are: debug, log, warn, error.

logAllCommunication.title: Log all LSP communication with the LSP servers
logAllCommunication.description: Whether all messages sent to and received from LSP servers should be logged into the console. To see these messages, set loggingLevel to debug or log. Note: Only messages handled by the new API will be shown.

setTrace.title: Ask servers to send trace notifications
setTrace.description: Whether to ask server to send logs with execution trace (for debugging). To see these messages, set loggingLevel to debug or log. Accepted values are: "off", "messages", "verbose". Servers are allowed to ignore this request.

ignoredLanguages.title: Ignored missing languages
ignoredLanguages.description: Languages for which missing servers should be ignored in the status indicator.

disable.title: Disable
disable.description: Disable this feature. Requires reloading JupyterLab to apply changes.

closeCharacters.title: Close characters
closeCharacters.description: An array of characters which should close the signature help. The signature help may be shown again after typing a character from this list if the server requests it to open.

maxLines.title: Number of lines to show without collapsing
maxLines.description: The number of documentation lines to show without collapsing into the details section.

disable.description: Disable this feature. Requires reloading JupyterLab to apply changes.

throttlerDelay.title: Throttler delay
throttlerDelay.description: Number of milliseconds to delay sending out the hover request to the language server.

disable.title: Disable
disable.description: Disable this feature. Requires reloading JupyterLab to apply changes.

foreignCodeThreshold.title: Threshold of foreign code coverage for changing the mode in an editor
foreignCodeThreshold.description: If a code editor includes a code fragment in another language (for example a %%markdown magic in IPython) with appropriate foreign code extractor defined, and the extend of this code (coverage of the editor) passes the threshold, the syntax highlighting (i.e. the mode) will change to provide highlighting for the language of the foreign code.
